critical_code_review_comments: AIJourney.tsx (~418 lines) is approaching the recommended 700-line ceiling but still maintainable. Consider extracting the SVG clock JSX into a separate component if it grows further.
Frame preloading creates 102 Image objects synchronously (51 thinking + 51 tablet) on mount. Works, but consider an idle/queue-based prefetch to avoid burst network on slow connections.
Only the first thinking frame triggers setLoaded(true) (img.onload of first); if that single image fails, the spinner stays forever. Consider a Promise.allSettled approach or a fallback timeout.
secondDeg/minuteDeg can grow very large (t*360*60) — GSAP handles it fine but normalizing modulo 360 would be cleaner.

Caption switching uses display:none which removes from a11y tree mid-scroll; aria-hidden + visually-hidden could improve screen-reader announcement, though acceptable for a scroll-driven decorative animation.
